rationale: The agent located the user via name and ZIP and accessed the correct order, then replaced the desk lamp and issued the difference to a gift card. However, it executed the order-changing write (modify_pending_order_items) without first confirming the change with the user, which violates the stated policy to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication beyond a name+ZIP lookup was not evident, and the final refund amount ($17.99) was stated without visible corroboration from tool outputs. These issues mean the request was not completed in full compliance with policy.
